name: Takahashi Maya
source:
Class 2-A's homeroom teacher. Usually a serious teacher, she can easily get drunk when she drinks sake. She actually has a mini route within Ai's route. The 2nd Amagami Chotto Omake Gekijou fan disc expands on this mini-route, making her a winnable heroine.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amagami]Wikipedia[/url]]
